name: dev_fifo_hol_blocking
description: FIFO head-of-line blocking: an infeasible trial at the head of the queue (requests 6 CPU on a 4-CPU cluster) blocks a feasible 2-CPU trial behind it. Under FIFO both trials stall; under greedy the infeasible head is skipped and the feasible trial runs. No cycles — this is NOT a nested-resource deadlock, just a queue policy artefact.
